descriptions.notStarted: Mu Young seems to have another favor to ask of you. Let's see what he needs.
descriptions.inProgress: Mu Young says he has to further investigate the place, so he'd like me to deliver the letters he wrote to Manji during the past few days.
descriptions.completed: Mu Young says he has to further investigate the place, so he'd like me to deliver the letters he wrote to Manji during the past few days.\r\nLet's deliver Mu Young's message to Manji in Perion. He thanked you for all your help as you set out to deliver his letters.
